div.head: Northu 66
div.ab: Gif ænig man heonan forð rihte laga wyrde, gebete hit georne.
Gif ænig man heonan forð rihte laga wyrde, gebete hit georne.
Wenn jemand hinfort rechte Satzungen verletzt, büsse er es ernstlich.
If anyone henceforth violates the right laws, let him atone for it earnestly.
If anyone henceforth violates just laws, he is to compensate for it eagerly.
Henceforth, if anyone violates just laws, he is to atone for it sincerely.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
Clauses 46 f. are repeated here, perhaps only through the confusion of the scribe, Liebermann thinks.
